```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## GENOMIC PREDICTION: GBLUP (RKHS) and BRR on three marker sets per trait:

   (1) GWAS  : GWAS-selected SNPs
   (2) Random: random SNPs, same number as the GWAS set (control)
   (3) All   : all polymorphic SNPs

## Model: y = Xb + g + Wp + e
   X = Origin * Trial + Julian (fixed), W = Trial:Repeat (random plot)
   g = u ~ N(0, G s2u)  (GBLUP)   or   Z beta (BRR)

## Efficiency:
  - genotype file is read/transposed once; genotypes are processed in
    SNP chunks (two light passes), geno2 is then removed
  - ONE centred, mean-imputed marker matrix; G (all SNPs) is accumulated
    chunk-wise; only the GWAS/random columns are kept in a small matrix
  - design matrices and CV folds are built once per trait and are
    identical across marker sets (paired comparison)
  - results are written per trait x marker set; finished ones are skipped
    so an interrupted run can be resumed



```{r cars}
############################################################
## LOAD PACKAGES
############################################################

library(BGLR)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)

## ---------------- settings ----------------
run_all_brr <- TRUE      # BRR on all SNPs needs n x 582,900 doubles in RAM
                         # (~2.3 GB per 500 individuals); FALSE = GBLUP only
marker_sets <- c("GWAS", "Random", "All")
chunk_size  <- 50000
runs        <- c(3647, 123, 5, 638166, 600)      # CV seeds
n_iter <- 5000; burn_in <- 2000; thin <- 10
out_dir  <- "GP_results"
bglr_tmp <- file.path(tempdir(), "bglr_")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


############################################################
## LOAD PHENOTYPE + COVARIATES
############################################################

pheno <- read.table("phenotype_data_746.txt", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
for (i in 2:ncol(pheno)) pheno[, i] <- as.numeric(pheno[, i])
colnames(pheno)[1] <- "taxa"
pheno$taxa <- gsub("-", "_", pheno$taxa)

cov <- read.table("phenotype_data_746_plot_info.txt", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
cov <- cov[, c("Name", "Origin", "Trial", "Repeat", "julian_2021", "julian_2022")]
colnames(cov)[colnames(cov) == "Name"] <- "taxa"
cov$taxa <- gsub("-", "_", cov$taxa)

cov$Trial  <- factor(cov$Trial, levels = c("Harz", "Unterlüß"))
cov$Repeat <- factor(ifelse(cov$Repeat %in% c("repeat1", "repeat4"), 1,
                     ifelse(cov$Repeat %in% c("repeat2", "repeat5"), 2, 3)))
cov$Origin <- factor(dplyr::recode(
  cov$Origin,
  "Horbylunde, Denmark" = 1, "Dean Sutton Bottow, Great britain" = 2,
  "Recklinghausen, Germany" = 3, "Dean Blackney, Great britain" = 4,
  "Elmstein-Nord, Germany" = 5, "Dymock, Great britain" = 6,
  "Bussieres, France" = 7, "Voillé, Frankreich" = 8), levels = 1:8)

if (anyDuplicated(cov$taxa) > 0) stop("Duplicated taxa in covariate data")

## trait columns: every *_2021 / *_2022 phenotype column (no hard-coded indices)
trait_names <- setdiff(grep("_(2021|2022)$", colnames(pheno), value = TRUE),
                       c("julian_2021", "julian_2022"))
cat("Traits:", paste(trait_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")


############################################################
## LOAD GENOTYPES
############################################################

geno <- read.table("genotype_data_582900.txt", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(geno) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(geno))
geno2 <- data.frame(taxa = colnames(geno)[-c(1:9)],
                    t(geno[, -c(1:9)]), check.names = FALSE)
colnames(geno2)[-1] <- geno$ID
geno2$taxa <- gsub("-", "_", geno2$taxa)
rm(geno); invisible(gc())
if (anyDuplicated(geno2$taxa) > 0) stop("Duplicated taxa in genotype data")

taxa_all <- geno2$taxa
n_ind    <- nrow(geno2)
snp_cols <- setdiff(colnames(geno2), "taxa")
chunks   <- seq(1, length(snp_cols), by = chunk_size)


############################################################
## PASS 1: allele frequencies, polymorphic SNPs
############################################################

p_all <- numeric(length(snp_cols))
for (s in chunks) {
  ii <- s:min(s + chunk_size - 1, length(snp_cols))
  Mc <- as.matrix(geno2[, snp_cols[ii], drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(Mc) <- "numeric"
  p_all[ii] <- colMeans(Mc, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  rm(Mc)
}
keep_all   <- is.finite(p_all) & p_all > 0 & p_all < 1
kept_names <- snp_cols[keep_all]
p_kept     <- setNames(p_all[keep_all], kept_names)
denom_all  <- sum(2 * p_kept * (1 - p_kept))
cat("Polymorphic SNPs:", length(kept_names), "of", length(snp_cols), "\n")


############################################################
## MARKER SETS: GWAS-selected and random (same size, non-GWAS SNPs)
############################################################

read_snps <- function(trait_name) {
  x <- read.table(paste0("selected_snps_", trait_name, ".txt"),
                  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  sub("^[0-9]+\\s+", "", x$x)
}

rand_seeds <- c(runs, 777)                # one seed per trait (original seeds kept)
gwas_list <- list(); random_list <- list()
for (k in seq_along(trait_names)) {
  tn <- trait_names[k]
  gw <- intersect(read_snps(tn), kept_names)           # drop missing/monomorphic
  set.seed(rand_seeds[k])
  rd <- sample(setdiff(kept_names, gw), length(gw))
  gwas_list[[tn]]   <- gw
  random_list[[tn]] <- rd
  cat(tn, ": GWAS SNPs =", length(gw), "| random SNPs =", length(rd), "\n")
}
needed <- unique(c(unlist(gwas_list), unlist(random_list)))


############################################################
## PASS 2: centre + mean-impute; accumulate G (all SNPs);
## keep only needed columns (and optionally everything for BRR)
############################################################

G_num <- matrix(0, n_ind, n_ind)
M_all <- if (run_all_brr) matrix(0, n_ind, length(kept_names)) else NULL
sub_parts <- list(); sub_names <- character(0)
col_pos <- 0L; n_miss <- 0

for (s in chunks) {
  ii <- s:min(s + chunk_size - 1, length(snp_cols))
  kk <- keep_all[ii]
  if (!any(kk)) next
  nm <- snp_cols[ii][kk]
  Mc <- as.matrix(geno2[, nm, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(Mc) <- "numeric"
  Mc <- sweep(Mc, 2, 2 * p_kept[nm], "-")              # centre
  na <- is.na(Mc); n_miss <- n_miss + sum(na); Mc[na] <- 0   # mean imputation

  G_num <- G_num + tcrossprod(Mc)
  if (run_all_brr) M_all[, col_pos + seq_len(ncol(Mc))] <- Mc
  sel <- nm %in% needed
  if (any(sel)) { sub_parts[[length(sub_parts) + 1]] <- Mc[, sel, drop = FALSE]
                  sub_names <- c(sub_names, nm[sel]) }
  col_pos <- col_pos + ncol(Mc)
  cat("SNP chunk", s, "done | SNPs stored:", col_pos, "\n")
  rm(Mc, na)
}
rm(geno2); invisible(gc())

M_sub <- do.call(cbind, sub_parts); colnames(M_sub) <- sub_names
rownames(M_sub) <- taxa_all
if (run_all_brr) rownames(M_all) <- taxa_all
rm(sub_parts)

G_all <- G_num / denom_all
rownames(G_all) <- colnames(G_all) <- taxa_all
rm(G_num); invisible(gc())
if (!all(is.finite(G_all))) stop("G (all SNPs) contains NA/NaN/Inf")
cat("Missing genotypes imputed:", n_miss, "\n")
saveRDS(G_all, file.path(out_dir, "G_matrix_all_SNPs.rds"))


############################################################
## HELPERS
############################################################

calc_accuracy <- function(obs, pred) {
  ok <- complete.cases(obs, pred); obs <- obs[ok]; pred <- pred[ok]
  if (length(obs) < 2) return(c(Correlation = NA, RMSE = NA))
  c(Correlation = cor(obs, pred), RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2)))
}

fit_eval <- function(ETA, yNa, y, test) {
  fit <- BGLR(y = yNa, ETA = ETA, nIter = n_iter, burnIn = burn_in,
              thin = thin, verbose = FALSE, saveAt = bglr_tmp)
  acc <- calc_accuracy(y[test], fit$yHat[test])
  rm(fit); invisible(gc())
  acc
}

make_row <- function(trait, set, model, f, run, acc)
  data.frame(trait = trait, marker_set = set, model = model, Fold = f, Run = run,
             Pred = round(acc["Correlation"], 4), Error = round(acc["RMSE"], 4),
             row.names = NULL)

## marker inputs for one trait x marker set, in the order of trait_geno
get_markers <- function(set, trait_name, taxa_trait) {
  idx <- match(taxa_trait, taxa_all)
  if (set == "All") {
    M <- NULL
    if (run_all_brr)
      M <- if (identical(idx, seq_len(n_ind))) M_all else M_all[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    return(list(G = G_all[idx, idx], M = M, n_snp = length(kept_names)))
  }
  snps <- if (set == "GWAS") gwas_list[[trait_name]] else random_list[[trait_name]]
  M <- M_sub[idx, snps, drop = FALSE]
  G <- tcrossprod(M) / sum(2 * p_kept[snps] * (1 - p_kept[snps]))
  list(G = G, M = M, n_snp = length(snps))
}


############################################################
## LOOP OVER TRAITS x MARKER SETS
############################################################

for (trait_name in trait_names) {

  cat("\n\n========================================\nTrait:", trait_name,
      "\n========================================\n")

  julian_var <- if (grepl("_2021$", trait_name)) "julian_2021" else "julian_2022"

  trait_i <- pheno[, c("taxa", trait_name), drop = FALSE] %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[trait_name]]))
  trait_geno <- data.frame(taxa = taxa_all) %>%
    left_join(cov, by = "taxa") %>%
    left_join(trait_i, by = "taxa") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Trial), !is.na(Repeat), !is.na(Origin), !is.na(.data[[julian_var]]),
           !is.na(.data[[trait_name]]))
  cat("Individuals used:", nrow(trait_geno), "\n")

  y <- trait_geno[[trait_name]]
  X_fixed  <- model.matrix(as.formula(paste0("~ Origin * Trial + ", julian_var)),
                           data = trait_geno)
  W_repeat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + interaction(Trial, Repeat), data = trait_geno)

  ## identical folds for every marker set (paired comparison)
  folds_list <- lapply(runs, function(s) { set.seed(s)
    createFolds(y = y, k = 10, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE) })

  for (set in marker_sets) {

    out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Pred_res_", set, "_", trait_name, ".txt"))
    if (file.exists(out_file)) { cat("Skipping (done):", out_file, "\n"); next }

    mk <- get_markers(set, trait_name, trait_geno$taxa)
    cat("\n--- Marker set:", set, "| SNPs:", mk$n_snp, "---\n")
    if (!all(is.finite(mk$G))) stop("G contains NA/NaN/Inf: ", trait_name, " / ", set)

    do_brr <- !is.null(mk$M)
    res <- NULL

    for (run in seq_along(runs)) {
      for (f in seq_along(folds_list[[run]])) {
        test <- folds_list[[run]][[f]]
        yNa <- y; yNa[test] <- NA

        ## GBLUP: y = Xb + u + Wp + e
        acc_G <- fit_eval(list(list(model = "FIXED", X = X_fixed),
                               list(model = "RKHS",  K = mk$G),
                               list(model = "BRR",   X = W_repeat)), yNa, y, test)
        res <- rbind(res, make_row(trait_name, set, "GBLUP", f, run, acc_G))

        ## BRR: y = Xb + Zg + Wp + e
        acc_B <- c(Correlation = NA, RMSE = NA)
        if (do_brr) {
          acc_B <- fit_eval(list(list(model = "FIXED", X = X_fixed),
                                 list(model = "BRR",   X = mk$M),
                                 list(model = "BRR",   X = W_repeat)), yNa, y, test)
          res <- rbind(res, make_row(trait_name, set, "BRR", f, run, acc_B))
        }
        cat(sprintf("%s | %s | run %d fold %2d | GBLUP r = %.3f | BRR r = %.3f\n",
                    trait_name, set, run, f, acc_G["Correlation"], acc_B["Correlation"]))
      }
    }

    write.table(res, out_file, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")
    print(res %>% group_by(marker_set, model) %>%
            summarise(mean_r = mean(Pred, na.rm = TRUE), sd_r = sd(Pred, na.rm = TRUE),
                      mean_RMSE = mean(Error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"))
    rm(mk, res); invisible(gc())
  }
}


############################################################
## COMBINE ALL RESULTS
############################################################

files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "^Pred_res_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
all_res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, read.table, header = TRUE, sep = "\t"))
write.table(all_res, file.path(out_dir, "Pred_res_ALL.txt"),
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")

all_res %>% group_by(trait, marker_set, model) %>%
  summarise(mean_r = mean(Pred, na.rm = TRUE), sd_r = sd(Pred, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_RMSE = mean(Error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
